_doc: The set of vitest projects that declare a coverage block, recorded by NAME. Read by
WHY A SET AND NOT A COUNT (#2724). This replaced `emitting.length >= 3`, a hand-typed floor
that had to be edited by hand every time the thing it counted changed, and whose failure mode
was silence. It went slack twice within hours of being written: #2695 set it at exactly 3,
#2720 correctly added apps/marketing and ee (real count 5), #2724 was filed, and by the time it
was fixed packages/format had made it 6 — so a tripwire written to catch ONE project leaving
A set cannot go slack the way a floor can. A project that disappears is named, so the failure
says which one instead of only that the number is smaller. A project that appears also fails,
asking for this file to be updated in a reviewed diff — which is the same ratchet discipline
coverage-floors.json already uses for the numbers themselves, applied to the sweep that guards
TO UPDATE: add or remove the project here in the same PR that adds or removes its coverage
block, and say which in the message. That diff is the review.
